browser_automation: fix silent 120s LLM-call stall from a timeout race with browser-use's own llm_timeout
root_cause: Two independent 120s timeouts (our primary_invoke_timeout_sec and browser-use's own llm_timeout) raced on every browser LLM call; browser-use's outer asyncio.wait_for() structurally won and cancelled our nested call via asyncio.CancelledError, a BaseException since Python 3.8 not caught by our except handlers -> full 120s silent stall, zero log output.
solution: Raised browser-use's llm_timeout 120->130 (browser_llm.py) so our own timeout always fires and logs first; added except asyncio.CancelledError backstop in ainvoke() logging before re-raise. Full sync_from_prod.sh into experiments/nexy_real_pipeline_check vendor copy.
